Unit square N16/32/64; cosine-plus-linear exact field. x walls Neumann±1; y walls analytic Robin alpha1,beta.5. Use f=5pi²cos(pi*x)cos(2pi*y),outward Neumann±1 on x walls and analytic alpha*u+beta*dn(u)=g on y walls.
